select mp.product_id as productId, mp.category_id as categoryId, mp.product_name as productName, mp.unit_name as unitName, mp.market_price as marketPrice, mp.sale_price as salePrice, mp.cover_image as coverImage, mp.detail_images as detailImages, mp.video_url as videoUrl, mp.freight_amount as freightAmount, mp.stock_total as stockTotal, mp.sales_count as salesCount, mp.shelf_status as shelfStatus, mp.sort_num as sortNum, mp.del_flag as delFlag, mp.create_time as createTime, mp.update_time as updateTime, mp.remark as remark from mall_product mp where mp.del_flag = 0 and mp.shelf_status = 1

and mp.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
